metadata.name: No Man's Field
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Two walled compounds face each other across a band of five lanes, each sealed halfway by a force field that stops people but not bullets. Every 8 seconds the clock opens the next lanes in a fixed rotation (west pair, centre, east pair, then the maintenance tunnel underneath while every lane is shut), and a red lamp blinks over a lane for the 2 seconds before it opens. The railed catwalk over the band is always open, and always in sight. Flags sit in pillboxes; each team spawns in a barracks only it can open.

do.text: No Man's Field: the lanes open in turn every 8 seconds. Watch the red lamps.

rules.name: After the east pair, the tunnel
